description: Authored synthetic expectations for candidate alerts, including desired improvements beyond literal patterns; not exploitability ground truth or real-project accuracy.
label_semantics: expected_match means a desired rule candidate alert in this authored fixture. True does not establish an exploitable vulnerability; false does not establish application safety. TP/FP/FN/TN describe agreement with these expectations only.

review_assumptions.review_kind: Separate model-based source and label review on 2026-11-10; not a human assessment, independent external benchmark, compiled application test, or exploit validation.
review_assumptions.access-vuln: The method receives an annotated ID but returns a constant. It is an ID-parameter candidate-pattern control, not an IDOR demonstration.
review_assumptions.absence_controls: auth-safe, access-safe, upload-safe, ssrf-safe, and pathtraversal-safe omit the relevant feature. They test absence of the candidate pattern, not recognition of an effective defense.
review_assumptions.environment: CSRF requires authentication and request context; CORS requires framework-version and actual response behavior; SSRF requires attacker control of the URL and a reachable server-side call. These fixtures do not establish those conditions.
review_assumptions.cors-different-receivers: Different variable names are a syntactic negative control; they do not prove the two parameters cannot alias one object.
review_assumptions.sql: JDBC direct/helper and MyBatis interpolation are risk-retaining positive expectations assuming an externally controlled, unvalidated term/title. Parameter binding is the negative control for this input path only.
review_assumptions.xss-frontend-safe: The negative expectation assumes the imported DOMPurify is authentic, operates normally with a suitable supported version/configuration, and the sanitized value is not subsequently made unsafe. No browser/runtime validation was performed.

cases.known_limitation: The broad v-html regex also flags a DOMPurify.sanitize-wrapped binding. Count this false alarm; confirm sanitizer behavior in review.

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
class Search { JdbcTemplate jdbc; Object search(String term) { return jdbc.queryForList("SELECT * FROM account WHERE name = '" + term + "'"); } }

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
class Search { JdbcTemplate jdbc; Object search(String term) { return jdbc.queryForList("SELECT * FROM account WHERE name = ?", term); } }

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
class Search { JdbcTemplate jdbc; Object search(String term) { return jdbc.queryForList(sql(term)); } String sql(String term) { return "SELECT * FROM account WHERE name = '" + term + "'"; } }
